items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: “From the Park Central Hotel and now the King of the Drums, Chick Webb.”

ctx.x: I’m trying to figure out how to introduce you, and you’ve done so many things I’ll just call you a musician and a friend of musicians.

Well I’m pleased that you said that, but I was a drummer, and there’s a difference. I was very pleased and fortunate to have been able to fulfill my dreams and hopes because I started to play when I was about five years old, banging on pots and pans like most of us did. And the reason I got to do that was my sister was a very fine singer. She was like a child star. And she worked with Buddy Rich when he was Traps the Drum Wonder. And so for some reason when they took me to rehearsal to watch her, I would watch…
And he tap danced too, didn’t he?
